crossRefs.note: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.
“How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have…
You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day, and the next day.
translations.bsb: “Stay here one more day,” David said to Uriah, “and tomorrow I will send you back.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next.
translations.kjv: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.
translations.asv: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to-day also, and to-morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.
